body:
Id like to share my experience with some very common herbs, that when combined have quite amazing affects. First a little background on myself though. Im your average 30 year old, hard workn, pot smokn aussie. I have tried and become addicted to many other substances (natural and synthetic) in my past but good ol mary jane is the only thats stuck by my side the whole time.
Ive always been lookn for that legal alternative that was cheaper than dope that actually worked, tried all sorts of bullshit in an attempt to replicate the feeling that mj gave me but to no avail. So I gave up looking and just dealt with the financial burden of buying that sweet sweet ganja. Last year I could not get any hoona from anyone, anywhere. It was like some stoner alien thief had flown in and beamed it all up. So I started my search again for that legal smoke that didnt exist. I came across a site and the shit he had was herbal incense and it was expensive as hell!!! Like 3 or 4 times the price of weed. So I emailed them and asked what the go was why the hell is this shit so expensive? He replied Because its better than weed! So I ordered some and soon figured out I was smoking random herbs laced with a chemical from the jwh range e.g jwh-018. It was pretty damn good though! I really loved that stuff, so bought more. Then came into some dope and decided the herbal incense was just too expensive.
Again just the other day I couldnt get mj so decided to order some more incense. This time decided to try and find another supplier (there was only one in aus until recent), found this site that sold aussie chill extreme. It was cheaper than my old supplier and apparently stronger so I ordered some. Initially I assumed I was smoking another jwh product, but there was something distinctly different with this mix, so I emailed the maker and asked him what type of chemicals he had used. He responded by advising me there were no synthetic chemicals used, it was all dried herbs and herbal extracts.
I smoked a cone and waited about a minute, felt a little light headed but nothing major. Tasted kinda spicy. So had another 3 and waited 5 mins and then bang!! It hit me, just like a MJ high but with a twist. The twist is hard to explain, maybe a slight loss of balance with a bit of an extra haze. I though to myself this is niiiiccceee!! I waited about 15 more minutes and had another 3 cones and it kicked me right back in my seat. My eyes felt a little red and I had a very cerebral stone with a slight body done. Very relaxing. This lasted for about 45 mins before it petered off. I topped up with a couple of extra cones and was right back to where I started. I am very impressed with this mix.
One week on Ive smoke the mix everyday with no real negative side effects. The tolerance has built up a little but hardly noticeable. Have noticed if I smoke on an empty stomach I get a slight headache. Otherwise all good. Still quite amazed at the similarity to mj!
